items.name: llm.complete
items.since: Introduced anna-app-runtime v0.2.0 · current v0.13.0 / dispatcher 0.17.0
items.direction: Bundle (iframe) → Host RPC → app_llm_facade.complete → LangChain ChatOpenAI → provider
items.summary: Stateless single-shot chat completion against the **user's chosen** LLM provider / model — your bundle never sees an API key, never hard-codes a model name, and the request is billed against the user's existing quota and provider routing. MCP-shaped: the request mirrors `sampling/createMessage` (`messages`, `maxTokens`, `temperature`, `modelPreferences`, `systemPrompt`, `stopSequences`) and the response mirrors the MCP result (`role`, `content: {type:'text', text}`, `model`, `stopReason`, `usage`).

wire.auth: Handled by the host page — the bundle never sees the token. Transport details (`POST /api/v1/anna-apps/runtime/rpc`, `X-Anna-App-Token`, envelope wrapping) are described once in the section overview.
wire.upstream: LangChain `ChatOpenAI` against `LLMProviderService.select_model_by_preferences(...)` — provider, base_url, api_key, and `cost_multiplier` all resolved server-side.

items.signature: anna.llm.complete(args: {messages: Array<{role:'user'|'assistant'|'system', content: string|object}>, maxTokens?: number, temperature?: number, modelPreferences?: {hints?: object, costPriority?: number, speedPriority?: number, intelligencePriority?: number}, systemPrompt?: string, stopSequences?: string[], metadata?: object}, opts?: {timeoutMs?: number}) => Promise<{role:'assistant', content:{type:'text', text:string}, model:string, stopReason:string, usage:{inputTokens:number, outputTokens:number, totalTokens:number}, _meta?:{provider:string|null, latencyMs:number, quotaConsumed:number, appSessionUuid:string}}>

params.name: messages
params.summary: Ordered chat transcript to complete. `role` is `user` / `assistant` / `system`. `content` is a string OR an MCP-shaped block (`{type:'text', text}` / `{type:'image', ...}`); blocks are flattened into a LangChain `HumanMessage` / `AIMessage` / `SystemMessage` by `_assemble_lc_messages`.
notes: Order is preserved verbatim — caller is responsible for trimming context to the model's window.
Image content blocks require the selected model to be multimodal; otherwise the provider rejects upstream and the call surfaces as `APP_PROVIDER_ERROR`.

params.name: maxTokens
params.summary: Hard cap on output tokens. Silently clamped down to `session.quota_caps.max_tokens_per_call` — the grant's per-call ceiling intersected with what the user actually granted to *this* app.
notes: Clamping is silent — caller does not see the reduced value (read `usage.outputTokens` to confirm what landed).
Per-app cap is set at install time via `UserAnnaApp.custom_config.llm_grant.quota_caps.max_tokens_per_call`; defaults to 4096 if neither side declares one.

params.name: temperature
params.summary: Sampling temperature passed through to the provider. Default `0.7` when omitted.

params.name: modelPreferences
params.summary: Soft routing hints consumed by `LLMProviderService.select_model_by_preferences`. The user's grant ALWAYS overrides — preferences only break ties between providers the user actually enabled.
notes: `hints` is an arbitrary dict (e.g. `{family: 'claude'}`); the selector pattern-matches against `LLMModel.metadata`.
Priorities are floats in `[0, 1]`; higher means "more important".
If no eligible model is available for the user, the call raises `APP_PROVIDER_ERROR` (`no eligible model available`).

params.name: systemPrompt
params.summary: Optional system prompt prepended as a `SystemMessage` before `messages`. Use this for app-specific persona / format instructions instead of injecting into `messages[0]`.

params.name: stopSequences
params.summary: Forwarded as the provider's `stop` parameter. Caller must trim — the host does not validate length / count limits.

params.name: metadata
params.summary: Free-form caller-side tagging. NOT forwarded to the provider; reserved for future telemetry.

returns.desc:
MCP-shaped completion result.

**Fields**
• `role`: always `'assistant'`.
• `content`: `{type: 'text', text: <model output>}`. Only text is returned today; multimodal output (image / tool_use blocks) is not exposed via `llm.complete` — use `agent.session.run` if you need that.
• `model`: the model_name actually selected (after `modelPreferences` resolution + user grant filtering) — store this if you need to audit later.
• `stopReason`: always `'endTurn'` today (provider-specific stop reasons are not yet surfaced).
• `usage`: token counts as reported by the provider; `totalTokens` falls back to `inputTokens + outputTokens` if the provider omits it.
• `_meta`: **optional** host-only extension (the cloud facade always populates it, but it is NOT part of the MCP result contract — treat it as best-effort and do not hard-depend on its presence).
• `_meta.provider`: human-readable provider name (e.g. `OpenAI`, `Anthropic`).
• `_meta.latencyMs`: end-to-end wall-clock including selector + provider call.
• `_meta.quotaConsumed`: float — the actual quota debited (provider cost × `cost_multiplier`). Useful for showing in-UI "X credits used".
• `_meta.appSessionUuid`: the lazy-minted `AnnaAppSession.uuid` (kind=`complete`). Same uuid is reused across all `llm.complete` calls from the same window for the token's TTL.

errors.name: APP_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: User has no `UserAnnaApp.custom_config.llm_grant` block for this app, the grant exists but `enabled: false`, the user has no active subscription, or the user row was deleted between auth and dispatch. `details.jsonrpc_code = -32001`.

errors.name: APP_QUOTA_EXCEEDED
errors.desc: Pre-flight `check_quota_available` failed OR post-call `check_and_consume_quota_with_redis` failed. Either way, no quota is double-charged — the latter raises *after* the model already returned, so the response is dropped and the caller retries. `details.jsonrpc_code = -32015`.

errors.name: APP_PROVIDER_ERROR
errors.desc: Selector found no eligible model, or LangChain `ainvoke` raised (network error, provider 5xx, content filter, etc.). The original exception type + message is included in the error text. `details.jsonrpc_code = -32003`.

errors.name: APP_SESSION_REVOKED
errors.desc: The cached `app_session_token` was revoked server-side (admin action / grant rotated). Caller should reset state and retry — the next call mints a fresh session. `details.jsonrpc_code = -32011`.

errors.name: not_implemented
errors.desc: Store does not support `llm_complete` (local-dev harness without a facade bridge).

errors.name: not_found
errors.desc: Resolved `user_id` no longer exists (token validated but row deleted between auth and dispatch).

limitations: Non-streaming. The response arrives in one chunk after the provider finishes — for token-by-token UI use `agent.session.run` (LangGraph streaming over `rpc.stream`).

Text output only. Multimodal blocks in the request (`{type:'image'}` etc.) are accepted by the message assembler but only `text` blocks come back in `content`. Tool-use / structured-output workflows belong to `agent.session.run`.
`maxTokens` clamping is silent — callers asking for 100k against a 4k cap get a 4k response with no warning. Read back `usage.outputTokens` if you need to detect truncation.
`stopReason` is hard-coded `'endTurn'`; provider-specific stops (content_filter, tool_use, length) are not yet surfaced. Detect length-stops by comparing `usage.outputTokens` to your `maxTokens`.
No conversation state. Each call is independent — the lazy-minted `app_session_uuid` is cached server-side only for token reuse, NOT for prompt history. Caller MUST resend full `messages` every call.
`metadata` is currently ignored end-to-end; do not rely on it for telemetry.
Per-call deadline default is `DEFAULT_TIMEOUTS_BY_NS.llm = 180_000` ms in the SDK; longer waits require an explicit `{ timeoutMs }`.
Selector errors (no eligible model) are reported as `APP_PROVIDER_ERROR`, not a dedicated code — branch on `e.message` containing `"no eligible model"` if you need to distinguish.

items.name: llm.stream
items.kind: Host API method · iframe surface · streaming
items.since: Introduced anna-app-runtime v0.10.0 / dispatcher 0.12.0 · current v0.13.0 / dispatcher 0.17.0
items.direction: Bundle (iframe) → Host RPC → worker-dispatched app_llm_facade.stream_completion → frames pushed back over `rpc.stream` events
items.summary: Streaming variant of `llm.complete` — same request shape, but the SDK returns an async-iterable `RpcStream`: `for await` yields `{event:'model_token', text}` incremental frames, and the final `{event:'complete', role, content, model, usage, _meta}` frame mirrors the `llm.complete` response exactly. Generation runs on the worker fleet (same single-producer dispatch as `agent.session.run`); frames arrive via the window's `rpc.stream` event channel and are reassembled by the SDK — your bundle just iterates.

wire.auth: Handled by the host page — same envelope as `llm.complete`. The RPC returns `{stream_id}` synchronously; token frames arrive as `rpc.stream` events tagged with that id.
wire.upstream: `app_llm_facade.stream_completion` — LangChain `chat.astream(stream_usage=True)`; quota check-and-consume runs at stream end.

items.signature: anna.llm.stream(args: {messages: Array<{role, content}>, maxTokens?: number, temperature?: number, modelPreferences?: object, systemPrompt?: string, stopSequences?: string[], metadata?: object}, opts?: {timeoutMs?: number}) => RpcStream<{event:'model_token', text:string} | {event:'complete', role:'assistant', content:{type:'text',text:string}, model:string, usage:object, _meta?:object}>

params.name: (all)
params.summary: Identical to `llm.complete`: `messages` (required), `maxTokens` (silently clamped to `quota_caps.max_tokens_per_call`), `temperature`, `modelPreferences`, `systemPrompt`, `stopSequences`, `metadata`. See the `llm.complete` entry for full per-param semantics — the request travels the same validation path.

returns.desc:
Frames in order:
• zero or more `{event:'model_token', text}` — incremental output; concatenating `text` yields the full completion.
• exactly one terminal `{event:'complete', role, content, model, usage, _meta}` — byte-equivalent to the `llm.complete` result (quota consumed at this point).
On provider failure the stream throws; partial tokens already delivered stay delivered but are NOT billed as a successful completion.

errors.name: APP_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: Same grant model as `llm.complete` (`ui.host_api.llm` must contain `stream` or `*`, plus the user-side `llm_grant`).

errors.name: APP_QUOTA_EXCEEDED
errors.desc: Pre-flight or end-of-stream consume failed — the terminal frame is replaced by a stream error; no double-charge.

limitations: Requires the worker fleet — in `anna-app dev` the harness bridges to `POST /api/v1/copilot/app/complete/stream` (SSE) instead; behavior matches but latency profile differs.
Stop-sequence / provider-specific stop reasons are not surfaced per-frame; only the terminal frame carries `usage`.
Frames share the window's `rpc.stream` event channel — iterate promptly; an abandoned iterator keeps the stream buffered until timeout (`llm` namespace default 180 000 ms).
